svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 18 (plan): scanning a receipt
svg.text: 18 · Scanning a receipt: the photo, the machine read, the holder confirms (holder, phone)
New for the plan (M3): optional; the read only suggests, and nothing counts until the holder confirms the total and each pizza's price.
A · The money step after arrival

g.text: It sets the order's total and, when read,
The photo goes to Anthropic to be read.
You check the result before it counts.
Without the reader the photo is kept

svg.text: B · The photo
C · The machine read, to check
D · No reader: type the total

g.text: Even shares unless every pizza has a price

svg.text: E · Confirmed

g.text: Seen by you, the crew and

svg.text: Optional
The money step appears after arrival and
stays open for the holder until 06:00 the
next day, also after done; the crew can add it. Skipping it
leaves the order with no total, and the
record says so.
The read only suggests (M3 A)
It fills the total and matches each
receipt line to the order's pizzas by
menu number and name. The holder
confirms or corrects; nothing counts
before that.
Differences are shown, never hidden
A price unlike the menu's is marked. A
line that matches no pizza, or a pizza
with no line, is asked about.
Extras
Delivery fees and discounts are split
per pizza (D7 note): €3.00 over 6 pizzas
is €0.50 a pizza.
No reader, or reader off
The holder types the total on the amount
pad and may still add the photo; it is
kept, not read.
Who sees a receipt, how long
The holder, the crew and the organiser,
since a receipt can show card digits.
Deleted at the 12-month anonymisation
